document.title: Public money for the arts
document.question:
Some people think that governments should spend public money on the arts, such as museums, theatres and orchestras, even though this money could be used for more essential services, such as healthcare and education.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
